parsed.reason: The message gets the deadline wrong. The facts give tonight at 11:00 p.m., but the text says it runs out tomorrow at 9 a.m. It also contradicts itself, since 2 hours from 9 p.m. is 11 p.m. tonight. It does not explain that the clock is the town's 36-hour response window counted from the parent's own message. It does correctly tell the parent to check email and the portal.
